title: 第 15 章 这变态没对你做什么吧
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
看到从浴池当中浮上来的人居然是一个外门男弟子，此刻苏婉清整个人都愣住了，只见她脸上的表情也从震惊变成了愤怒。

    “你是什么人，居然敢躲在这里偷看我洗澡！”苏婉清怒声道。

    下意识的往后退了几步以后她整个人靠在池壁上，双手护在胸前脸色难看。

    当陈默从池水中浮上来之后也是一脸的无语。

    没想到修炼得好好的居然会被人撞见，而且这个人还是苏婉清。

    “我不是有意在此。”陈默说道。

    “人赃并获你还狡辩？你躲在这浴池底下不是偷看我洗澡还能是为了什么，难道你要跟我说你是来这里修炼的不成。”

    这时的陈默张了张嘴想要解释一下但话到嘴边又咽了回去，心想算了这种误会怎么解释都解释不清楚。

    “随便你怎么想吧，反正我没有偷看。”陈默说道。

    当苏婉清听到这句话之后更加愤怒了，特别是脸色一下子都铁青了起来。

    “你这个变态还敢狡辩，我今天非要把你抓到执法堂去不可。”

    可陈默却没有继续跟她争论下去而是转身朝浴池边上走去，准备离开这个地方免得事情越闹越大。

    但是他刚走了两步身后的苏婉清又开口了，而且她的声音之中还多了一丝质问他的意思。

    “等等你给我站住。”

    只见陈默停下脚步转过头看着她，那苏婉清盯着他的脸看了好一会儿眉头忽然皱了起来。

    “你该不会就是上次闯进我房间的那个人吧。”苏婉清说道。

    当陈默听到这句话之后心里愣了一下，看来这下冲突在所难免了。

    上次闯进她房间的事情要是被翻出来，那就真的说不清楚了。

    “我不知道你在说什么。”陈默说道。

    “不知道我在说什么，你不承认也没关系我迟早会查出来的。”

    然而陈默没有再说话他转身便继续朝池边走去，可身后的苏婉清却忽然发出一声惊呼。

    “怎么回事！”

    当陈默转过头以后就看到苏婉清的脸色变得极其难看，能注意到她的身子微微颤抖就连额头上还冒出了冷汗。

    “你方才对我做了什么。”苏婉清盯着陈默问道。

    就在这时苏婉清咬着牙尝试调动体内的真元，可是不管她怎么努力。

    体内的真元都无法运转起来，就像是被什么东西堵住了一样。

    糟了！

    该不会是练功的时候出了岔子吧，怎么偏偏在这个时候出问题。

    要是眼前这个变态趁人之危对她做什么的话，以她现在这个样子根本反抗不了。

    只见苏婉清的脸色从愤怒逐渐变得紧张了起来。

    盯着陈默的眼神里也多了几分警惕和不安。
content_en:
Su Wanqing was stunned when she saw that the person emerging from the bath was actually a male disciple of the outer sect. The expression on her face changed from shock to anger.

    "Who are you? How dare you hide here and watch me take a shower!" Su Wanqing said angrily.

    After subconsciously taking a few steps back, she leaned against the wall of the pool with her hands on her chest and looked ugly.

    When Chen Mo came up from the pool, he was also speechless.

    I didn't expect that someone who was practicing well would be bumped into, and this person was Su Wanqing.

    "I didn't mean to be here." Chen Mo said.

    "You've got stolen goods and you're still making excuses? What else could you be hiding under this bathtub to watch me take a bath? Do you want to tell me that you're here to practice?"

    At this time, Chen Mo opened his mouth to explain, but he swallowed the words again, thinking to himself, forget it, no matter how you explain this misunderstanding, you can't explain it.

    "Whatever you think, I didn't peek anyway." Chen Mo said.

    When Su Wanqing heard this, she became even more angry, especially her face suddenly turned livid.

    "You pervert still dare to quibble, I have to take you to the law enforcement hall today."

    But Chen Mo did not continue to argue with her. Instead, he turned around and walked towards the edge of the bath, preparing to leave this place to avoid making things worse.

    But just after he took two steps, Su Wanqing, who was behind him, spoke again, and there was a hint of questioning in her voice.

    "Wait a minute and stop."

    Chen Mo stopped and turned to look at her. Su Wanqing stared at his face for a while and suddenly frowned.

    "Are you the one who broke into my room last time?" Su Wanqing said.

    When Chen Mo heard this sentence, he was stunned for a moment. It seemed that this conflict was inevitable.

    If what happened when he broke into her room last time was revealed, it would really be hard to explain.

    "I don't know what you are talking about." Chen Mo said.

    "I don't know what I'm talking about. It doesn't matter if you don't admit it. I will find out sooner or later."

    However, Chen Mo didn't say anything anymore. He turned around and continued walking towards the pool, but Su Wanqing behind him suddenly let out an exclamation.

    "What's going on!"

    When Chen Mo turned around, he saw that Su Wanqing's face had become extremely ugly. She could notice that her body was trembling slightly and even cold sweat broke out on her forehead.

    "What did you just do to me?" Su Wanqing stared at Chen Mo and asked.

    At this moment, Su Wanqing gritted her teeth and tried to mobilize the true energy in her body, but no matter how hard she tried.

    None of the true energy in the body could move, as if it was blocked by something.

    Oops!

    Could it be that something went wrong during practice? Why did the problem happen at this time?

    If the pervert in front of her did something to her while she was in danger, she wouldn't be able to resist in her current state.

    Su Wanqing's face gradually turned from angry to nervous.

    The eyes staring at Chen Mo were a little more wary and uneasy.
title_en: Chapter 15 This pervert didn’t do anything to you, right?
